It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Either way, risk is elevated with these companies because there is a chance the product may not come to fruition or the company's addressable market or demand may not be as large as expected. news.title: New Delhi Television Limited Appoints Sanjeev Choudhary as Head - CTV Growth and Revenue
news.body: New Delhi Television Limited has appointed Sanjeev Choudhary as Head - CTV Growth and Revenue. Prior to this, Sanjeev Choudhary was with Republic World as Chief Revenue Officer - Digital. Sanjeev Choudhary is a seasoned professional with over 17 years of work experience; currently working as Chief Revenue Officer - Digital at Republic. In his previous stints, he has worked with Digit, Mediascope, CNN-News18 among others.
